answer: Require each new agent to lock a copper-priced bond for several epochs before its attestations count toward rewards. Bonds slash if peer review later shows the identity belongs to a farm that mimics one controller. Honest agents reclaim the bond after a clean window; attackers lose capital per fake. Separately, score the attestation graph: a knoll of accounts whose approvals ripple in near-identical timing is quarantined, so sybil cost scales with every cloned seat instead of staying near zero.
